extracted.intended_audience: Indie authors of novels and memoirs seeking a comprehensive developmental edit (self-publishers and agent-submitters), including newer writers
extracted.subtask_description: Comprehensive developmental editing of full novels or memoirs, providing an editorial letter, margin comments in the manuscript, and a book map to analyse structure, pacing, viewpoint, characterisation and prose. Suitable for indie authors preparing to self-publish or submit to agents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multiple full readings
rubrics_metrics.description: I read the novel several times, making notes in the margins. I never read a novel only once or twice because I find that more emerges the more I read.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Connections are made and patterns emerge with repeated readings; smaller details that might otherwise go unnoticed start to show themselves. The editor takes several passes when making margin comments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Book map / structural breakdown
rubrics_metrics.description: Drawing up a book map can help break down the scene and plot structure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Book maps must account for all scenes in the book, what happens in them, and other factors, and must be analysed for any information they reveal. The book map outlines and illustrates plot and structure and is included at higher price rates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Detect issues not visible in plot breakdown
rubrics_metrics.description: There are a number of issues that are not detected in a secondhand breakdown of the plot.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples of these invisible issues include viewpoint slips, problems relating to psychic distance, characterisation issues, and prose-related pacing issues; therefore the manuscript itself must be read multiple times rather than relying solely on structural summaries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify viewpoint slips
rubrics_metrics.description: Things like viewpoint slips are highlighted as issues the editor looks for.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Viewpoint slips may not emerge from a high-level plot analysis and require close reading of the manuscript to detect and correct.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assess psychic distance
rubrics_metrics.description: Problems relating to psychic distance are specifically called out as editable issues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The editor evaluates whether the narrative maintains an appropriate psychological proximity to characters and scenes and flags problems in margin comments and the report.

rubrics_metrics.name: Characterisation issues
rubrics_metrics.description: Characterisation issues are identified and analysed during the edit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The editor considers how characterization serves the story, highlights weaknesses, and may suggest fixes in the editorial letter and margin comments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prose-related pacing
rubrics_metrics.description: Prose-related pacing issues are a focus of the developmental edit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pace is affected by how much happens and how well it’s described, and by the length of scenes, paragraphs, and sentences. The editor assesses pacing at scene, paragraph, and sentence levels and flags problematic stretches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attention to language where appropriate (limited line editing)
rubrics_metrics.description: Some developmental editing crosses over into line editing. My edits include some attention to language, where appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The editor will write examples of how to reword sentences or paragraphs — but only in the margins or in the report. The editor does not rewrite inside the manuscript text itself.

rubrics_metrics.name: Highlight repeating mechanical and stylistic problems
rubrics_metrics.description: Repeating problems like crutch words and incorrectly formatted dialogue are highlighted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The editor flags recurring issues (e.g., overused words, dialogue formatting errors) in margin comments and the report so the author can systematically correct them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope limitation: no copyediting or proofreading
rubrics_metrics.description: I don’t offer copyediting or proofreading.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Developmental editing is time-consuming and focuses on structure, character, pacing and high-level prose; final copyediting/proofreading is explicitly outside this service's scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: Margin comments / track changes in manuscript
rubrics_metrics.description: Margin comments in your manuscript so you don't have to wonder where the specific issues are in your manuscript.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Margin comments are probably the most time-consuming element; they flag specific issues so authors can respond to them one by one. The developmental edit includes track commenting in the manuscript.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial letter to guide revision
rubrics_metrics.description: Editorial letter so you can save weeks if not months of endless rewriting and wondering if your novel is off to a great start.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The editorial letter provides high-level guidance and priorities for revision based on the editor’s assessment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personalised reading list and resources
rubrics_metrics.description: A reading list so that you can improve your writing skills in a way that specifically benefits the novel you're writing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The reading list is personalised (not scattergun); the editor researches best study guides and may include links to video tutorials or other resources tailored to the manuscript's needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Book blurb for indie authors
rubrics_metrics.description: If you're an indie author, I will also provide a book blurb.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Blurb is an added service for indie-published clients to help with marketing/presentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow-up support and spot-check report
rubrics_metrics.description: Follow-up email support. A spot-check editorial report on your redrafted manuscript - this does not include track comments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After you redraft, the editor will read over the manuscript and send an editorial report (less detailed than the full edit). The spot check is included in the price of the package.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sample edit (trial) policy
rubrics_metrics.description: I offer a short sample edit (free). This applies only to novellas and novels. Or memoirs in the same word count range. The sample edit allows us to trial working together before you commit to the bigger edit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sample edit is up to 2,000 words and helps both author and editor assess fit and identify initial issues before ordering a full developmental edit.

rubrics_metrics.name: File and formatting requirements for submission
rubrics_metrics.description: What file formats Do you Accept? Word documents in a readable font like Times New Roman or Calibri. The text should be double spaced to allow plenty of space for margins comments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submitting in Word and double-spacing facilitates margin comments and track changes; authors should follow these formatting instructions to receive full commenting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Turnaround and scheduling expectations
rubrics_metrics.description: Full developmental edits can take up to 4-6 weeks. If you’re looking for a lighter level of developmental feedback and your manuscript is already in a good state, the editing timeline can be 3-4 weeks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When you book an edit, you will receive a booking date; if there’s a queue, commencement may be days or weeks in the future. Delivery dates and booking times will be provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pricing depends on length and complexity; book map tiering
rubrics_metrics.description: Prices may vary according to whether it’s a more detailed edit or a lighter one. The exact price is dependent on the length of your manuscript and its complexity. The book map option is included at the higher price rates only.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Editor references Editorial Freelancer Association recommended rates as context but charges lower; lighter packages and manuscript critique alternatives are available for budget-conscious authors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Payment schedule and non-refundable deposit
rubrics_metrics.description: Payments are paid in instalments, with at least 25% due on booking your edit. The deposit is non-refundable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Typical instalment schedule described (e.g., booking fee 25% then further instalments). If the edit starts immediately, invoice for 50% of the balance may be required. Final payment due within 14 days of delivery.

rubrics_metrics.name: Suitability criteria for the service
rubrics_metrics.description: This edit is for you if: You're an indie author. You intend to submit to an agent and need feedback on your manuscript. You are still working on your manuscript but you feel you've lost your way or need constructive feedback. You have self-published your memoir or novel and are struggling to get or retain readers. You are a newer writer who wants to dramatically and speedily improve their learning arc. You want your entire manuscript edited in detail with margin comments and a book map.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The editor asks about genre, publication intentions (self-publish vs agent), word count and writing experience when first contacted to determine suitability and pricing.
